basis: Producer has 260 distinct semantic atom sets after removing names, numbers, refs, wording and ownership. Auditor uses 12 proposition structures composed with distinct gap/uncertainty configurations and five relation families, with decision-bearing core/evidence/epistemic/qualifier changes; each normalized full comparison signature is unique. This is compositional task expansion, not 600 independently collected natural documents.
resolved_findings: Separated numbered claims from annex gap scope
Replaced ambiguous question changes with evidence misattribution
Clarified delivered omissions versus interrupted transport prospectively
Excluded 40 Producer calibration rows from substantive credit
limitations: Only five conservative structural superfamilies; document IDs are not statistical independence
Reusable finite grammar and stock clauses limit linguistic diversity
Five synthetic insufficiency structures and fixed quantities limit out-of-distribution claims
Producer review shares the frozen finite ontology and structural parsing
Auditor source/extraction labels reviewed blind, but target rationale rendering is author-curated and mechanically checked
No human review, no model-performance evidence, no protected comparison
rationale_review: Authored concise explanations checked against explicit source/extraction deltas. Independent blind predictions agree on all relation labels; no claim of blinded target-rationale review.
